The footprints were further clustered with a similarity threshold of 0.7 and coverage threshold of 0.9 using MMSEQ2; alignment by "FAMSA for clusters including >500 sequences, muscle5 with the super5 option for clusters including 101-500 sequences and muscle5 with the mpc option for clusters including <=100 sequences"; "the resulting alignment was used as a PSI-BLAST query against all cluster sequences and sequences matching <75% of the profile length were removed"; "Each resulting 0.7 similarity cluster was used as a PSI-BLAST query against the prokaryotic database to identify hits (e-value cutoff of 0.0001) outside CRISPR-cas islands, which were treated as false positives"
iterations: Further clustering was performed using the neighbour-joining method until convergence. In each neighbour-joining iteration, sequences from the closest cluster profile pair were merged, a new profile was generated... and the distance matrix was recalculated. Clusters were merged only if the PSI-BLAST results for the merged profile contained more than 98% of the original sequences and no more than ten new false positives (except Cas3 and CARF genes, where false-positive counts were not used...)
target_db: the 47,545-genome prokaryotic protein database (and clustered NR for rare families)
search_unit: domain envelope (PSI-BLAST footprint), re-mapped because "the legacy Cas protein profiles (Pfam, CD, COG and previously constructed custom profiles) often include inconsistently defined boundaries for the same domain, their footprints could differ strongly with respect to mapping on the protein structure"
curation: explicit sensitivity/specificity accounting per merge (>98% of original sequences retained, <=10 new false positives); hits outside CRISPR-cas islands counted as false positives; manual review of resulting clusters; "Clusters containing <=3 sequences were removed if those sequences were represented in the PSI-BLAST results (e-value cutoff of 0.0001) of larger clusters"
context_step: island membership (inside vs outside a CRISPR-cas island) is the false-positive criterion
clustering: MMseqs2 0.9 representatives, then footprint clustering at 0.7/0.9; hierarchical clustering with tree-depth cutoff 0.8; neighbour-joining merging to convergence
downstream: the 915-PSSM set used for the census; separate near-full-length and RuvC-only profiles for all Cas12 families; separate N- and C-terminal HEPN profiles for all Cas13 families
scale: 915 PSSMs including 293 new ones
published_artifacts: data files 5 and 6 (the curated alignments and PSSMs) at Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.17388109

seed: protein clusters of Cas families that do not readily align (Cas8/Cas10, Cas12, Cas13, Cas7, Cas5, Cas11, CARF)
tool: relative HHSEARCH scores... were obtained for cluster comparison and converted to distances using the negative log transformation. Hierarchical unweighted pair group method with arithmetic mean (UPGMA) dendrograms were then constructed using scipy.cluster.hierarchy and the average method in Python or hclust and the average method in R; hybrid dendrograms: "the FastTree program... was used to infer relationships within alignable clusters and the relationships between these clusters were inferred from HHalign pairwise scores using the matrix-based UPGMA approach... The FastTree trees built for clusters were grafted onto the tips of the profile similarity-based UPGMA dendrogram"
target_db: the paper's own Cas cluster profiles (profile-profile, not a sequence database)
curation: normalisation by self-scores; settings given per figure legend; used only where sequence alignment fails
context_step: not applicable
clustering: UPGMA on profile-profile distances; hybrid grafting of FastTree subtrees
downstream: evolutionary classification of subtypes; Cas10/CARF hybrid dendrogram (Fig. 3a)
scale: not stated
published_artifacts: data file 4 (trees and dendrograms) at Zenodo

seed: representative Cas7, Cas8 and Cas10 proteins of type I and III subtypes (AF2 models and PDB structures)

To do so, full Cas8 and Cas10 structures have been compared against individual Cas3 and Cas11 structures available in PDB by foldseek. After mapping, fused Cas3, Cas5 and Cas11 domains were removed, if applicable, and the core Cas8 and Cas10 proteins kept; then "compared all-versus-all using DALI"

downstream: AlphaFold3 (default settings) modelling of III-G, III-H and III-I effector complexes with stated subunit stoichiometries and crRNA lengths ("7xCas7_1, 1xCas7_2, 1xCas5, 1xCas10, crRNA (48 nt) and crRNA (38 nt)")

seed: cas1 genes and effector genes (cas8, cas9, cas10, cas12) within the same locus
tool: A rough estimate of the extent of recombination between modules within CRISPR-cas loci was obtained by tallying the co-occurrence of cas1 with distinct effector genes (cas8, cas9, cas10 or cas12) within the same locus. curation: explicitly "producing a conservative estimate of inter-module swaps"; asymmetric clustering thresholds (90% for the adaptation marker, 50% for the effector) chosen to avoid overcalling
